note: Cross-chat memory recall set for the D77 walk (tree.rs tests). One project, several chats and one subagent session, shaped like real history: user and assistant turns, a tool call with a long output, a 45-minute gap that splits an episode. `t` is minutes before 'now'. Each case asks from a chat that does not hold the answer; `gold` substrings must appear in the pack, `expect_empty` cases must inject nothing.

leaves.text: Hi Bob. My name is Jacob, remember that. I live in Austin and I am allergic to peanuts.
Got it, Jacob. Austin, and a peanut allergy — I will keep both in mind.
Also my GitHub handle is unconst, in case you need it for repos.
Noted: your GitHub handle is @unconst.
What can you do for me here?
I can run code, browse, manage files in this workspace, and start subagents for long jobs.
Our cat Whiskers keeps scratching the couch. Any ideas?
A tall sisal scratching post next to the couch, double-sided tape on the armrests for two weeks, and trim Whiskers' claws every ten days.
She is a three year old tabby, if that matters.
It does not change the plan; a young tabby just needs the post to be taller than she is when stretched.
